Method of Attack: Exploited zero-day CVE-2021-20016 in SonicWall SMA 100 Series VPN appliances to deploy ransomware
Used ransomware to encrypt systems and steal source code
Used as backdoor variant installed after initial compromise
Ransomware deployed by UNC2447 affiliates for extortion
Used web shells to backdoor systems and move laterally through networks
Impacted Systems: Networks of North American and European targets
Video game development studio CD Projekt Red
Brazilian power company CEMIG (Companhia Energética de Minas Gerais)
SonicWall’s on-premises and hosted Email Security (ES) products
Attack Vector: Use of Cobalt Strike implants for persistence
Use of BEHINDER web shells for lateral movement
Date of Discovery: January 2021 (HelloKitty activity dwindled, FiveHands usage increased)
March 2021 (discovery of additional zero-days in SonicWall Email Security products)
